caption:
Bought a one bedroom condo to rent out? Finding a tenant was easy. Finding a buyer could be harder. 🏢

PropNex data reported by The Business Times: new launch one bedroom sales fell from about 1,800 a year (2010 to 2015) to about 500 (2021 to 2025), and some big new launches now have none at all. Resale went the other way: from about 100 deals a year to about 1,000. About 4 in 10 buyers are HDB upgraders, and small resale units cost around $818,000 against about $1.37M for new ones.

Fewer buyers want a one bedder, so when you sell, your price has to be right. Bigger layouts, good transport and a longer lease tend to sell more easily.
